description: After explicit user confirmation of exact inputs and total credits, submit all selected direct-generation approvals from one run in one call. Pass confirmation.items and totalCredits from the prepared request as items and maxCredits. Validates all client/user/run bindings before dispatch; preserves already-submitted items on retries and reports every partial failure. Never call before user confirmation. No Berrys review-page click is needed.

decision.description: Whether to approve or reject the selected proposal; approve charges only after explicit user confirmation.

approvalId.description: Approval ID from the prepared request or approvals_list.

inputFingerprint.description: Exact input fingerprint from the quote, binding approval to the reviewed inputs.

maxCredits.description: Maximum credits explicitly approved by the user; copy the quoted ceiling without increasing it.
Sum of the quoted credit ceilings for all selected items, explicitly confirmed by the user.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

runId.description: Run ID returned by preparation or execution for this project.

name: playground_generation_confirm

next.description: Suggested next action; it does not authorize spending.

title: Confirm generation batch
